description.narrative: The Honourable Minister of Trade and Industry, on behalf of the Government of Sierra Leone, requested UNIDO to support the Government on issues related to industry and trade through the formulation and eventual operationalisation of a new Country Programme (CP) in December 2018. In the Medium-Term Development Plan 2018-2023, the Government of Sierra Leone highlighted industrialization as one of its key priorities to address two of the seven pillars to accelerate and diversify the economy as well as supporting infrastructure and economic competitiveness. The Plan also envisions that industrialisation would support exports increase and decrease of import dependency, creation of jobs, and empowerment of women, through enterprise and skills development and generation of wealth. The received letter of request for a CP development also acknowledged the importance of effective partnerships, as well as UNIDO#s role in partnership and resource mobilization and its valuable contribution to the country#s economic development and inclusive growth through provision of technical assistance and support over the years.
